# Knowledge Check

1. Which signal do GNSS receivers use? [Select one]
A. Sound
B. Radio

2. Select all that apply. Which are sensors?
A. Accelerometer
B. Thermometer
C. Keyboard

# Answers

1. B: Radio signals come from satellites.
2. A and B: Both are sensors.

# Key terms

| Term | Definition |
|------|------------|
| GNSS | Global Navigation Satellite System |
| Sensor | Device that measures a physical quantity |
